description.en: ONECYL evaluates graph-based surrogate models for unsteady flow past a circular cylinder across laminar, transitional, and high-Reynolds-number regimes using 450 high-fidelity simulations with randomized geometries, time-resolved fields, and mesh connectivity.

evaluationEvidence.reuse: The ONECYL benchmark and its Graph Transformer baseline provide a reproducible framework for evaluating graph-based surrogate models and establish a foundation for future research on long-horizon prediction of unsteady bluff-body flows.
evaluationEvidence.scoring: ONECYL establishes a unified evaluation framework combining full-field rollout errors, virtual probes, and drag and lift predictions to assess numerical accuracy and physical fidelity.
evaluationEvidence.task: The benchmark comprises 450 high-fidelity Variational Multiscale finite-element simulations (270,000 flow snapshots) with randomized cylinder geometries, providing time-resolved velocity and pressure fields together with mesh connectivity, geometric descriptors, Reynolds numbers, and integrated aerodynamic quantities.
